beats: A dim underground car park, a black luxury sedan with no badge parked among concrete pillars, the elevator doors glowing in the distance beyond its windshield.
@Khai sits behind the wheel drumming his fingers, and as @Vy slides into the passenger seat with a slim white folder, he turns to her with a sly grin and speaks.
@Vy settles into the seat, slides her sunglasses on and answers @Khai with a cool smile, her face and red lips clearly visible, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips, and @Khai taps the white folder in her lap with one finger, both of them smiling with closed mouths as the engine starts.
clips.sfx: fingers drumming on leather, a car door shutting, an engine starting, an echoing car park
clips.setting: Inside a black luxury sedan with no badge parked in a dim underground car park, the elevator doors glowing in the distance.

scenes.title: Quán Xôi Của Thu
scenes.location: Quán xôi nhỏ của Thu ở một góc phố cổ Hà Nội, trước bình minh.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ bên trái màn hình, vỉa hè và hàng người mua bên phải; máy quay đặt trong quán nhìn ra phố.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi lớn bốc khói, những gói xôi lá chuối, lạt tre, quầy gỗ cũ.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Sáu tháng nay ngày nào con cũng mở quán từ lúc trời còn tối, không mệt hả con?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Không mệt đâu mẹ, quán mình chẳng có biển hiệu gì, chỉ có nồi xôi ngon, mở muộn là khách phải chờ.

clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the pavement, slow crane down to the shop doorway
beats: A dark old-quarter street before dawn, yellow streetlamps glowing on mossy walls as warm light and thick steam spill from the small sticky-rice shop onto the empty pavement.
@Thu lifts a big pot lid behind the worn wooden counter as @BaNhan steps into the lit doorway with her carved bamboo walking stick and speaks fondly to her, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu answers her with a gentle smile while scooping glossy sticky rice onto a fresh banana leaf, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, setting a neat parcel on the rows along the counter, as @BaNhan shakes her head with a soft smile in the golden steam.
clips.sfx: steam hissing from big pots, a walking stick tapping the doorstep, roosters crowing in the alley

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Cô ơi, hàng dài đến tận đầu phố rồi, cô đi xe cả tiếng đồng hồ chỉ để mua xôi của mẹ cháu thật ạ? Cô chờ cháu lấy gói nóng nhất nhé!
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot down the queue, slow tracking alongside Na in the foreground
beats: The old-quarter pavement in front of the glowing shop, parked mopeds lining the curb under yellow streetlamps and the first pale blue light rising above the rooftops.
@Na walks into the foreground along the long queue carrying a tray of banana-leaf parcels, stops beside the young woman in a work blazer and speaks up to her with wide eyes, her lips clearly visible.
@Na keeps speaking with a wide little grin, tilting her head toward the shop, as the young woman smiles and nods with her mouth closed, the queue stretching back to the corner.
@Na finishes speaking and closes her mouth, lifting the warmest parcel from her tray up toward the young woman, the long queue glowing under the streetlamps behind them.
clips.sfx: shuffling footsteps, mopeds puttering far down the street, steam hissing from the shop
clips.extras: a long queue of office workers and students waiting under the streetlamps, a young woman in a work blazer at its front

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bà ơi, tay mẹ cháu thô ráp, sao gói xôi lại khéo thế hả bà?

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Người ta chê đôi tay ấy thô ráp, giờ chính nó nuôi cả nhà mình đấy, còn nhau là còn tất cả cháu ạ.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot from table height, slow lateral slide
beats: A low wooden table at the back of the shop piled with fresh green banana leaves, a bundle of bamboo strings and two small stools in the warm lamplight.
The camera slides to @Na kneeling at the table wrapping a parcel with a bamboo string as she looks up to ask @BaNhan, who sits on a stool folding banana leaves and listens with her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @BaNhan answers her warmly while knotting a bamboo string tight around a parcel, her wrinkled face and lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth with crinkled smiling eyes as @Na holds up her own neatly finished parcel, both of them grinning in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: banana leaves crinkling, bamboo strings tightening, steam hissing in the background

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Xôi hôm nay hết sớm rồi cả nhà ơi, mai mọi người quay lại nhé, em để phần trước cho, ai ở xa cứ gọi em, em gói sẵn mang đến tận nơi!
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the pavement facing the counter, slow push-in
beats: The worn wooden counter with an empty steaming pot and a few last banana-leaf parcels, warm yellow light falling across the wet pavement as the sky turns pale blue.
@Thu leans over the counter and speaks warmly to the few customers holding banana-leaf parcels, tilting the empty pot toward them to show its bare bottom.
@Thu keeps speaking with a bright smile and presses her palms together in a small apologetic bow as the customers nod and step back onto the pavement.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, then turns her rough, rice-flecked palms up in front of her and studies them, calm and upright in the first light of dawn.
clips.sfx: steam fading, distant mopeds passing, a ladle tapping the empty pot, birds waking in the alley
clips.extras: a few customers holding banana-leaf parcels

scenes.title: Công Ty Rỗng Ruột
scenes.location: Phòng giám đốc vách kính trên tầng cao, công ty xây dựng của Tùng; cuối cảnh là một con phố Hà Nội lúc chạng vạng.
scenes.axis: Bàn trắng ở giữa, cửa kính và đường chân trời phía sau Tùng; cửa ra vào bên phải màn hình.
scenes.props: Tập hồ sơ, giấy chuyển tiền chỉ có dòng mực mờ, điện thoại, mô hình tòa nhà, khung ảnh gia đình úp mặt.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Sao lại hủy hợp đồng? Tuần này đã ba bên hủy rồi, công trình còn đang làm dở, anh phải nói rõ lý do cho tôi chứ! Lại dập máy nữa rồi à?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow dolly across the office
beats: The glass-walled director's office in cold morning light, loose papers covered in faint unreadable lines scattered across the large white desk beside the architectural model of a residential tower.
@Tung strides in from the door holding his phone to his ear, its screen turned away, and speaks sharply into it, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking louder as he paces behind the desk, then lowers the phone and stares at it as the call goes silent in his hand.
@Tung closes his mouth and stares down at the scattered papers, one roof piece of the tower model sitting crooked on its top floor in the cold light.
clips.sfx: air conditioning hum, a phone ringing unanswered in the next room, a call clicking dead

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Chị nói sao? Tài khoản công ty mình chỉ còn vài trăm nghìn đồng thôi à? Tiền đâu hết rồi? Ai rút hết tiền của công ty tôi? Gọi Vy lên đây ngay!
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the accountant onto Tùng, slow push-in
beats: The large white desk with a black leather chair, a closed laptop and a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na lying face down beside a thick folder.
@Tung sits in the black leather chair, flips open the thick folder the accountant has set before him and speaks sharply up at her, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung rises from the chair still speaking, tapping a finger hard on the pages of faint unreadable figures as the accountant lowers her eyes and steps back a pace.
@Tung closes his mouth and leans on the desk edge with both hands, breathing hard, as the accountant hurries out through the glass door.
clips.sfx: paper sliding on the desk, a folder flipping open, heavy breathing, a glass door closing
clips.extras: a middle-aged woman accountant in a grey cardigan holding a folder

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Lệnh chuyển tiền nào cũng có chữ ký ủy quyền của Vy, người mà mình tin nhất đời. Nghe máy đi Vy, anh gọi em hai mươi cuộc rồi, sao chỉ toàn thuê bao thế này?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus from the transfer slips to his face
beats: A stack of transfer slips on the white desk in sharp focus, each covered in faint unreadable lines and the same blue ink scrawl at the bottom.
Focus racks to @Tung leaning over the desk behind the slips, sliding a finger from one blue scrawl to the next as he mutters to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking as he presses his phone to his ear, its softly glowing screen turned away from the camera, his eyes still fixed on the slips.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, lets the phone sink from his ear and stands motionless with his jaw slack in the cold office light.
clips.sfx: paper rustling, a phone ringing out again and again, a flat automated tone

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Công ty mất rồi, tiền cũng mất, Vy cũng chẳng thấy đâu, giờ mình biết đi đâu đây? Thôi, về nhà đã, ít ra mình vẫn còn căn nhà trong ngõ cũ chứ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot along the pavement
beats: A busy Hà Nội street at dusk, rush-hour mopeds streaming past far beyond a row of parked bikes, neon shop lights with no letters flickering on above the empty pavement.
@Tung walks slowly into frame along the pavement in his creased charcoal-grey suit, his collar askew, muttering to himself with his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking under his breath, stops beside a lamppost and rubs his face with one hand, his gold wristwatch glinting in the neon.
@Tung closes his mouth and turns down a narrow side alley, his shoulders hunched as the first drops of rain darken the pavement around him.
clips.sfx: rush-hour traffic roaring in the distance, horns, a buzzing neon tube, the first drops of rain
clips.setting: Dusk on a busy Hà Nội street, rush-hour mopeds, neon shop lights flickering on.

scenes.title: Sau Lớp Kính Quán Cà Phê
scenes.time_label: Tối mưa, quán cà phê quen của Vy (18:00–19:00)
scenes.location: Vỉa hè trước quán cà phê sang trọng quen của Vy trong đêm mưa, và bàn góc bên trong quán.
scenes.axis: Ngoài trời: Tùng đứng trên vỉa hè bên trái, cửa kính quán ở giữa. Trong quán: bàn góc cạnh cửa sổ, Vy ngồi ghế nhung bên phải, Tùng đứng bên trái.
scenes.props: Cửa kính mưa chảy, hai ly nước ép cao, bàn đá, túi xách trắng nhỏ của Vy.
scenes.setting: Rainy night on the pavement outside an upscale café, warm light glowing through tall rain-streaked windows.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Đèn quán quen của Vy vẫn sáng, cả ngày gọi không nghe máy, chắc cô ấy ngồi trong này. Kia rồi, thằng nào đang ngồi sát bên cô ấy, sao bụng cô ấy vẫn phẳng lì?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot along the wet pavement, slow push-in toward the glowing window
beats: Rain falls through the yellow glow of a streetlamp onto the empty wet pavement outside an upscale café, warm light glowing through its tall rain-streaked windows.
@Tung walks into frame in his soaked suit, stops in front of the glowing window and murmurs to himself, rain running down his face and his lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking as he steps closer to the glass and goes rigid, his eyes fixed on something inside the café, his breath fogging the pane.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, standing motionless in the pouring rain with his jaw clenched and his hands hanging open at his sides.
clips.sfx: steady rain on the pavement, water gurgling in a gutter, distant thunder

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Cụng ly đi em, lão Tùng mất sạch cơ nghiệp rồi mà vẫn đinh ninh sắp có con trai đấy.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Lão cứ việc mà mơ, sáng mai mình bay rồi, để lão ở lại ôm cái công ty rỗng.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot past the brass lamps, slow lateral slide
beats: A corner table of the upscale café, a marble top with two tall glasses of fruit juice, brass lamps glowing and rain streaking the window behind.
@Vy sits in a velvet armchair resting her head on @Khai's shoulder as he lifts his glass toward hers and speaks with a sly grin, while @Vy listens with her mouth closed.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy lifts her head and answers him with a smirk, her red lips clearly visible, one hand patting her flat stomach.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth as they clink glasses, both smiling widely, her small white handbag resting on the marble table beside them.
clips.sfx: glasses clinking, soft rain on the window, a coffee machine hissing
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Vy, thằng vừa ngồi đây là ai? Còn đứa con của anh, em giải thích cho anh nghe đi!

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Con nào hả anh? Que thử thai em mua mười nghìn ngoài hiệu thuốc đấy, anh ngây thơ thật.

clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot of the corner table, slow push-in
beats: Rain streaks down the café window beside a marble table where two half-finished glasses of fruit juice stand under a glowing brass lamp.
The camera reveals @Vy seated alone in a velvet armchair as @Tung walks up dripping wet and speaks hoarsely down at her, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy leans back, crosses her legs and answers him lightly and sharply, tapping her flat stomach with red-nailed fingertips.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth with a slow, mocking half-smile, while @Tung stands frozen and dripping an arm's length from the table.
clips.sfx: rain dripping from his clothes onto the floor, a hushed café, ice clinking in a glass
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thế ra từ đầu đến cuối em chỉ lừa anh thôi à, cả đứa con cũng là giả?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh tưởng em yêu cái bụng phệ của anh à? Em yêu tiền của anh thôi, giờ tiền hết rồi thì em đi, chào anh nhé.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow pan following her
beats: @Tung speaks hoarsely to @Vy with rain dripping from his chin and his voice cracking, while @Vy listens with her mouth closed and a bored look.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy rises from the velvet armchair, slings her small white handbag over her shoulder and answers him coolly from an arm's length away.
@Vy keeps speaking with a cold little shrug, her feline eyes on his face, then turns on her heel toward the café door.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth as she walks out through the glass door, leaving @Tung alone and dripping beside the empty table, staring after her.
clips.sfx: heels clicking, the café door swinging shut, rain rushing in for a moment
clips.setting: An upscale café at night: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows facing the street.

scenes.title: Căn Nhà Bị Niêm Phong
scenes.time_label: Đêm mưa đến rạng sáng, trước cổng nhà cũ (19:00–20:00)
scenes.location: Con ngõ nhỏ trước cổng sắt căn nhà ống cũ của gia đình, đêm mưa đến rạng sáng.
scenes.axis: Cổng sắt ở giữa màn hình, bậc cửa đá phía dưới; đèn đường bên trái; đầu ngõ ra phố ở phía máy quay.
scenes.props: Giấy niêm phong dán ngang cổng (chỉ có dòng chữ mờ không đọc được), điện thoại của Tùng, bậc cửa đá.
scenes.setting: Rainy night in a narrow Hà Nội alley outside a closed steel gate of a tube house, a paper seal stuck across the gate, a single streetlamp.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Ngân hàng niêm phong nhà rồi sao? Vy đem căn nhà này đi thế chấp từ bao giờ thế này? Giờ chẳng còn ai để gọi, vợ con, mẹ già, mình tự tay đuổi đi cả rồi.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot down the alley, slow push-in toward the gate
beats: A narrow rain-soaked alley at night, a single streetlamp lighting puddles and a closed steel gate with a long paper seal of faint unreadable lines pasted across it.
@Tung walks up to the sealed gate in his soaked suit, stares at the paper seal and speaks hoarsely to himself, his face and lips clearly visible under the streetlamp.
@Tung keeps speaking as he lays one palm flat on the wet iron bars beside the seal, then sinks down onto the worn stone doorstep below it.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, sitting hunched on the doorstep with his forearms on his knees and the dark phone in his hand as rain drips from the gate.
clips.sfx: heavy rain, water rushing in a gutter, a dog barking far away

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cái camera bếp Thu cài cho mình ngày xưa, không biết đoạn ghi hình cũ còn lưu không. Chiều hôm ấy đây rồi, Vy tự ngồi xuống cầu thang, tự ôm bụng, tự kêu lên mà.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up from step level, slow push-in
beats: @Tung lifts the phone from his knee and wipes the rain off it with his thumb, the screen turned away from the camera, his lips pressed shut.
@Tung speaks quietly to himself as he taps the phone, a pale glow lighting his wet face while the screen stays turned away from the camera.
@Tung keeps speaking as he shields the phone from the rain with his other hand, his eyes narrowing and tracking something small on the hidden screen.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, his eyes stop moving and his breath catches, his lips trembling in the cold glow.
clips.sfx: rain pattering on the phone, soft taps, thunder rolling

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thu chưa từng chạm vào cô ta, thế mà mình quát vào mặt vợ mười hai năm, chẳng một lời xin lỗi. Thu ơi, anh sai rồi, anh sai thật rồi em ơi.
clips.camera: 100mm extreme close-up on his face, slow push-in
beats: @Tung lowers the glowing phone onto his knee and stares into the rain-soaked alley, his mouth shut tight and rain running down his cheeks.
@Tung speaks hoarsely to himself, his face filling the frame in the cold glow from below, his lips clearly visible and trembling.
@Tung keeps speaking as his eyes squeeze shut and his voice breaks, his shoulders starting to shake under the soaked suit.
@Tung closes his mouth and presses the back of his hand against it, bowing his head as the phone's glow fades out below the frame.
clips.sfx: rain intensifying, a ragged breath, water dripping from the gate

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Trời sáng rồi. Mất hết rồi thì thôi, nhưng không thể để Vy với gã kia ôm tiền bỏ trốn, phải ra đồn công an tố cáo ngay, ít ra cũng làm được một việc tử tế.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot facing him in the alley, slow crane up
beats: Grey dawn light creeps into the narrow alley as the rain eases to a fine drizzle, the streetlamp still glowing beside the sealed steel gate.
@Tung rises into frame from the doorstep below, wipes his face with his sleeve and speaks quietly to himself with a set jaw, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking as he straightens his soaked jacket and slips the phone into his pocket, his eyes fixed on the mouth of the alley.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, walking away down the wet alley toward the brightening street with his back straight as the camera rises over the tiled roofs.
clips.sfx: light drizzle, footsteps on wet concrete, the first moped starting in the distance
clips.setting: Grey dawn in the same narrow Hà Nội alley outside the sealed steel gate, the rain easing to a drizzle, the streetlamp still on.

scenes.title: Chuyến Bay Không Cất Cánh
scenes.time_label: Sáng, sảnh ga đi sân bay (20:00–21:00)
scenes.location: Sảnh ga đi của một sân bay quốc tế, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Quầy làm thủ tục ở cuối hình; Vy và Khải đi từ trái sang phải; công an tiến tới từ phía quầy.
scenes.props: Vali kéo vỏ cứng, kính râm, túi xách trắng nhỏ của Vy, tờ lệnh bắt và thẻ lên máy bay (chỉ có dòng chữ mờ).
scenes.setting: A bright modern airport departure hall: polished stone floor, check-in counters, tall glass walls, travelers with suitcases in the distance.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Tiền chuyển sang tài khoản nước ngoài hết chưa em? Hôm nay bay rồi, không được sót đồng nào.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Hết rồi anh, cả công ty lẫn căn nhà của lão, giờ chỉ việc lên máy bay thôi.

clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow crane down through the hall to the pair
beats: A bright modern airport departure hall, morning sun pouring through the tall glass walls onto the polished stone floor as a white airliner rolls slowly along the distant runway beyond.
@Khai and @Vy walk into frame in dark sunglasses, each pulling a hard-shell suitcase, and @Khai leans toward @Vy speaking low while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy slips her hand into his and answers with an easy smile, her red lips clearly visible below her sunglasses.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth, and the pair stride hand in hand across the gleaming floor toward the check-in counters with relaxed shoulders.
clips.sfx: airport hall echo, a distant jet engine, suitcase wheels rolling on stone

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Qua được cửa này là mình giàu cả đời em ạ, lão Tùng giờ chắc đang ngồi khóc ở đâu đó.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Kệ lão, đàn ông ngu thì phải trả giá thôi, đi nhanh lên anh, sắp đến lượt mình rồi.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot tracking alongside them
beats: @Khai and @Vy walk hand in hand with their suitcases rolling behind them, both mouths closed, as @Khai slides his sunglasses down his nose with a sly look.
@Khai leans his head toward @Vy and speaks low with a sly grin, while @Vy listens behind her sunglasses with her mouth closed.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy answers him with a cold smirk, her red lips clearly visible, quickening her steps toward the counters.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her mouth, then slows down, her smirk fading as she stares ahead at something near the check-in counters.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels rolling on stone, heels clicking, a soft chime echoing in the hall

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Sao công an lại đứng chờ ngay quầy thủ tục, tờ giấy kia là lệnh bắt ai? Các anh nhầm người rồi, tôi là vợ giám đốc, các anh có biết tôi là ai không?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot onto Vy from the counter side, slow push-in
beats: The check-in counters in bright morning light, the polished stone floor stretching empty in front of them under the tall glass walls.
@Vy stops short with her suitcase as the two officers walk calmly toward her, one holding up a paper with faint unreadable lines, and she murmurs, her lips clearly visible.
@Vy pulls off her sunglasses and lifts her chin at the officers, speaking sharply as they stop a calm step away, one hand tightening on her small white handbag.
@Vy closes her mouth and her shoulders sag, the small white handbag sliding down to her wrist, while the two officers stand perfectly still and wait a calm step away.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels stopping, measured footsteps on stone, the hall falling quiet
clips.extras: two police officers in dark-green uniforms walking calmly toward her

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Thôi, giàu cả đời đâu chẳng thấy, hết đường chạy thật rồi. Các anh cứ làm việc đi, tôi tự giác đi theo, tiền giấu ở đâu tôi khai hết với các anh.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: A stretch of polished stone floor near the counters, a hard-shell suitcase standing upright in a pool of morning sunlight.
@Khai lets go of the suitcase handle and speaks quietly to the police officer standing calmly a step away, his sly grin gone and his lips clearly visible.
@Khai keeps speaking as he takes off his dark sunglasses and folds them into his shirt pocket, his eyes lowered to the stone floor.
@Khai closes his mouth and holds out both wrists toward the officer as a boarding pass with faint unreadable print slips from his fingers onto the cold stone floor.
clips.sfx: the suitcase settling on its wheels, a hushed hall, paper landing on stone, a distant jet engine fading
clips.extras: a police officer in a dark-green uniform standing calmly a step away from him

scenes.title: Gói Xôi Lúc Bình Minh
scenes.location: Quán xôi của Thu ở phố cổ, trước bình minh, một tuần sau.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ và Thu bên trái màn hình, vỉa hè và Tùng bên phải; máy quay đặt ngang quầy.
scenes.props: Gói xôi lá chuối nóng buộc lạt, nồi xôi bốc khói, quầy gỗ cũ.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Quán của Thu đây rồi, mình còn mặt mũi nào mà xếp hàng mua xôi của cô ấy nữa. Thôi, cứ đứng xa xa nhìn cô ấy một lúc thôi cũng được rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up from the far end of the pavement, slow rack focus from the glowing shop to his face
beats: The old-quarter street before dawn, the sticky-rice shop glowing soft and warm at the far end of a dark wet pavement, steam rising into the lamplight through a light drizzle.
@Tung steps into the foreground, gaunt in a creased rain-stained suit, and focus racks to his hollow face as he murmurs to himself, his lips clearly visible.
@Tung keeps speaking under his breath, his sunken eyes fixed on the warm light of the distant shop, his hands hanging empty at his sides.
@Tung closes his mouth and stands still in the drizzle, his shoulders hunched, the warm glow of the shop reflected in his wet eyes.
clips.sfx: light drizzle, steam hissing far away, a moped passing in the distance

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh Tùng? Sao anh gầy rộc thế này, anh đứng ngoài ấy từ bao giờ?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thu ơi, anh sai rồi, anh mù quáng thật rồi, em cho anh về với mẹ con em được không?

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the counter, slow push-in
beats: The worn wooden counter of the shop, banana-leaf parcels stacked beside a steaming pot under a warm bulb, drizzle glittering on the pavement beyond.
@Thu looks up from wrapping a parcel as @Tung steps up to the counter in his creased suit, and she speaks to him in a low, steady voice while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung rests both hands on the edge of the counter and answers her in a cracked, pleading voice, his eyes red-rimmed.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, lowering his gaze to the steaming pot, while @Thu stands still across the counter with the steam drifting between them.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, drizzle on the awning, his unsteady breathing

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Gói xôi này em mời anh, còn cơm nhà, chính anh đã tự tay bỏ đi rồi.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Xôi vẫn nóng như ngày xưa em đồ cho anh, thế mà anh từng chê xôi với chả xôi.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot across the counter, slow lateral slide
beats: @Thu silently wraps a fresh scoop of hot sticky rice in a banana leaf and knots a bamboo string around it, her lips pressed together, while @Tung waits across the counter.
@Thu holds the parcel out and speaks to @Tung calmly and evenly, setting it into his open hands without letting her fingers linger, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung stares down at the warm parcel in his hands and answers hoarsely, his lips clearly visible and trembling.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, tears dropping onto the green banana leaf, while @Thu straightens behind the counter with her hands folded on her apron.
clips.sfx: banana leaf crinkling, steam hissing, drizzle on the awning

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thu ơi, đến giờ em còn thương anh chút nào nữa không em?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Thương thì vẫn còn thương anh ạ, nhưng giờ em đã học được cách thương lấy chính mình rồi, anh ăn xôi cho nóng rồi về đi.

clips.camera: 35mm medium low-angle shot from the pavement, slow crane down
beats: The wet pavement in front of the shop glistening under warm light spilling from the counter, steam drifting over the curb in the fine drizzle.
@Tung sinks to his knees on the wet pavement in the foreground, holding the warm parcel against his chest, and speaks softly toward @Thu, who walks back to the steaming pot with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu stops at the pot without looking back and answers him softly, her face in profile to the camera and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, lifting the lid of the big pot in a cloud of golden steam, while @Tung stays kneeling on the pavement with the parcel against his chest.
clips.sfx: drizzle, knees meeting wet concrete, a pot lid lifting in a rush of steam

scenes.title: Mẹ Vẫn Là Mẹ
scenes.time_label: Tối, gác nhỏ trên quán xôi (22:00–23:00)
scenes.location: Căn gác nhỏ phía trên quán xôi, nơi bà Nhàn ở cùng Thu và bé Na; cầu thang gỗ dẫn lên cửa.
scenes.axis: Cửa gỗ bên phải màn hình, bà Nhàn đứng trong cửa, Tùng đứng ở ngưỡng cửa phía ngoài; bàn thờ và cửa sổ bên trái.
scenes.props: Gậy tre chạm của bà Nhàn, bàn thờ nhỏ với nén nhang, đèn bàn vàng, cửa gỗ.
scenes.setting: Evening in a small cozy room above the sticky-rice shop: a low wooden bed, a family altar with incense, a window over the old-quarter street, a warm lamp.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, con đứng ngoài này mãi mà không dám gõ cửa, mẹ còn nhận con không mẹ?

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Tùng đấy à? Mày đến đây làm gì? Mẹ già rồi, không còn gì cho mày lấy nữa đâu con.

clips.camera: 50mm medium profile shot across the top landing, slow push-in
beats: A narrow wooden staircase climbing to a closed door above the sticky-rice shop, a thin strip of warm light glowing underneath it.
@Tung climbs the last steps and stops before the closed door, one hand hovering short of the wood, and speaks softly toward it, his face and lips clearly visible in profile.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth as the door creaks open and @BaNhan appears in the doorway leaning on her carved bamboo walking stick, answering him with a hard, tired face.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth, keeping one hand on the door frame to bar the way in, while @Tung stands with his head lowered on the threshold.
clips.sfx: creaking wooden steps, the door creaking open, a walking stick tapping the floor
clips.setting: Evening on a narrow wooden staircase leading up to a closed door above the sticky-rice shop, warm light under the door.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Con không đến để lấy gì nữa đâu mẹ, con chỉ xin mẹ cho con được làm người tử tế lại.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Tử tế thì phải làm cả đời, mai con ra quán rửa bát, làm thuê cho con Thu đi.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot across the threshold, slow lateral slide
beats: Inside the cozy room above the shop, a warm lamp glowing and incense smoke curling from the small family altar beside the window over the lit street.
The camera slides to @Tung on the threshold as he lifts his red-rimmed eyes and speaks to @BaNhan in a low, breaking voice, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @BaNhan folds both hands on top of her bamboo walking stick and answers him firmly and slowly, her lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan finishes speaking, closes her mouth and taps the stick once on the floor, while @Tung nods without lifting his head in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: the lamp humming softly, the stick tapping on wood, a moped passing in the street below

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Vâng, con nghe mẹ, bao nhiêu năm con cãi mẹ rồi, từ nay mẹ bảo gì con cũng làm.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thôi về đi, sáng mai năm giờ có mặt ở quán, đừng để con Thu phải chờ.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at the doorway, slow pull back
beats: @Tung stands bowed on the threshold with his mouth closed while @BaNhan studies him for a long moment, her lips pressed into a thin trembling line.
@Tung lifts his wet eyes and answers @BaNhan in a low, steady voice, his chin trembling, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, bowing his head very low, and @BaNhan answers him gruffly, her wrinkled face and lips clearly visible in the lamplight.
@BaNhan finishes speaking, closes her mouth and slowly swings the wooden door shut, the last sliver of lamplight falling across @Tung's bowed head.
clips.sfx: a deep unsteady breath, the lamp hum, the door latch clicking shut

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Nó dại thì nó chịu, nhưng dù sao nó vẫn là đứa con mình mang nặng đẻ đau. Biết quay đầu thì vẫn còn kịp, mai mình để phần nó bát xôi nóng.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on Bà Nhàn against the door, slow push-in
beats: Inside the cozy room, the small family altar glows with incense smoke beside the window over the lit old-quarter street, the wooden door shut.
@BaNhan leans her back against the closed wooden door with both hands on her bamboo walking stick and murmurs to herself, her lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan keeps speaking softly as she turns her face toward the glowing altar, her chin trembling and her eyes glistening in the lamplight.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, lifts the cuff of her brown knitted cardigan and dabs her eyes, her wrinkled face softening into a small smile in the warm light.
clips.sfx: a soft sniff, incense crackling, slow footsteps going down the wooden stairs outside

scenes.title: Buổi Diễn Văn Nghệ
scenes.time_label: Chiều, hội trường trường tiểu học (23:00–24:00)
scenes.location: Hội trường trường tiểu học của bé Na, buổi diễn văn nghệ cuối năm; góc hậu trường sau buổi diễn.
scenes.axis: Sân khấu ở cuối hình, hàng ghế phụ huynh phía trước; Thu và Tùng ở hàng ghế cuối bên phải; hậu trường: cửa ra vào bên trái.
scenes.props: Trống con màu đỏ và dùi trống của Na, hoa giấy, dây cờ màu, ghế nhựa.
scenes.setting: Afternoon in a primary school hall: a small stage with paper flower decorations and colorful bunting, rows of plastic chairs filled with parents.

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bố có đến không nhỉ? Mẹ bảo hôm nay bố đến mà, sao con tìm mãi chẳng thấy đâu? Bố ơi, con đánh trống to thế này, bố có nghe thấy không?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from above the parents' heads, slow crane down to the front edge of the stage
beats: Colorful bunting and paper flowers strung high across a bright primary school hall in the afternoon, the small decorated stage glowing warm at the far end.
@Na marches to the front edge of the stage drumming on a small red drum, pauses and speaks to herself while scanning the rows of parents below, her lips clearly visible.
@Na keeps speaking as she rises on tiptoe and peers toward the back of the hall, her drumsticks frozen in mid-air above the drum.
@Na closes her mouth and starts drumming again, harder and faster, her bright eyes still searching the rows of parents below the stage.
clips.sfx: a small drum tapping a steady march, scattered applause, chairs creaking
clips.extras: rows of parents seated in plastic chairs below the stage

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Hội trường chật kín phụ huynh, thế mà chín năm nay anh chưa đến xem con lần nào.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Con bé tìm anh suốt từ nãy đấy, anh giơ tay vẫy đi cho con nhìn thấy bố.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot from the side, slow push-in
beats: The last row of plastic chairs at the back of the hall, warm light from the high windows falling across two empty seats and a strand of paper flowers.
@Tung sits stiffly beside @Thu in the last row and speaks quietly with glistening eyes fixed on the stage, while @Thu listens with her hands folded in her lap and her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu answers him softly without turning her head, her eyes on the stage and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth with a quiet smile as @Tung lifts one hand high and waves toward the stage, his chin trembling.
clips.sfx: the little drum from the stage, applause swelling, chairs creaking

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bố đến thật rồi! Bố ơi, lần sau bố đến sớm hơn để ngồi hàng đầu nhé.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Bố hứa, từ nay buổi diễn nào của con, bố cũng đến sớm nhất, ngồi hàng đầu tiên.

clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot from child height, slow push-in
beats: A quiet backstage corner of the school hall, paper flowers and folded bunting piled on a chair in soft afternoon light.
@Na runs into frame with her small red drum and stops in front of @Tung, looking up at him and speaking breathlessly, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung kneels down to her eye level and answers her softly and earnestly, holding up his little finger toward her.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth as @Na hooks her little finger around his, the two of them holding the pinky promise between them, both smiling.
clips.sfx: distant applause from the hall, quick small footsteps, paper decorations rustling
clips.setting: Backstage corner of the school hall after the show, paper decorations, soft afternoon light.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thu ơi, cảm ơn em đã cho anh được đến xem con hôm nay.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em tha thứ không phải để quay lại với anh, mà để con mình còn có bố, anh nhớ giữ lời hứa với con đấy.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot in the doorway, slow push-in
beats: A doorway at the edge of the backstage corner, soft afternoon light and a string of paper flowers hanging across it.
@Thu stands in the doorway with her hands folded in front of her as @Tung walks up and stops an arm's length away, speaking to her quietly, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu answers him evenly and gently, her eyes steady on his face and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, a small smile settling on her face as she looks past him toward the sound of a small drum, while @Tung nods slowly.
clips.sfx: soft applause fading, a small drum tapping nearby, a breeze through the paper flowers
clips.setting: Backstage corner of the school hall after the show, paper decorations, soft afternoon light.

scenes.title: Vợ Tào Khang
scenes.location: Quán xôi của Thu ở phố cổ, một năm sau, sáng sớm nắng vàng đầu tiên; cuối cảnh là toàn cảnh mái phố cổ từ trên cao.
scenes.axis: Quầy gỗ và nồi xôi bên trái, góc rửa bát của Tùng ở phía sau bên phải; phố ở phía trước máy quay.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi lớn bốc khói, chồng bát, chậu rửa, gói xôi lá chuối, ghế đẩu.
scenes.setting: Before dawn at Thu's small sticky-rice shop on a Hà Nội old-quarter street: a worn wooden counter, rows of banana-leaf parcels, big steaming pots, warm yellow light spilling onto the pavement.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mới một năm đã ba cửa hàng, sao con vẫn tự tay đồ mẻ xôi đầu hả con?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẻ đầu là mẻ của nhà mình mẹ ạ, tay con vẫn chai, nhưng lòng con giờ nhẹ lắm.

clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the street, slow push-in to the doorway
beats: The old-quarter street at first light, the sticky-rice shop's warm glow spilling across the pavement and thick steam billowing from a row of big pots behind the worn wooden counter.
@Thu lifts a steamer lid behind the counter as @BaNhan steps up beside it with her bamboo walking stick and speaks fondly to her, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu turns the glossy rice with a wooden paddle and answers her with a calm smile, her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, looking out at the street through the rising steam, as @BaNhan nods softly and the first gold sunlight touches the rooftops.
clips.sfx: steam roaring, a walking stick tapping the floor, sparrows chirping

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Một năm rửa bát rồi đấy, có còn thấy nhục không con?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Không đâu mẹ, làm thuê cho vợ cũ cũng được, mỗi cái bát rửa sạch là con trả bớt một chút nợ ân tình.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot in the back corner, slow lateral slide
beats: A corner at the back of the shop, a big plastic basin of soapy water and a tall stack of bowls on a low stool, steam drifting in from the front.
@Tung sits on a low stool with his white shirt sleeves rolled up, washing a bowl in the soapy basin, as @BaNhan pauses beside him on her walking stick and asks him gently.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung looks up at her and answers in a quiet, humble voice, his wet hands resting on the rim of the basin and his lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, setting a clean bowl on the tall stack, as @BaNhan gives a small approving nod and taps her stick once on the floor.
clips.sfx: water sloshing, bowls clinking, steam hissing in the background

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, sau này lớn lên con muốn giỏi giang như mẹ, không cần dựa vào ai cả.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Con cứ sống tử tế, chăm chỉ, ai bỏ con mà đi thì người thiệt là họ, không phải con.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot by the counter, slow push-in
beats: The front counter of the shop in golden morning light, a small stack of banana-leaf parcels and bamboo strings beside a steaming pot.
@Na in her school uniform hops onto a stool beside @Thu at the counter and looks up at her mother, speaking earnestly, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu wipes her hands on her dark-green apron and answers her gently and firmly, her eyes steady on her daughter and her lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, handing @Na a warm banana-leaf parcel for school as @Na nods hard, both of them smiling in the golden light.
clips.sfx: morning street sounds, steam hissing, a stool scraping, a banana leaf crinkling

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Thế sao ngày xưa bố lại bỏ mẹ đi tìm cô khác hả mẹ?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Người ta có thể đi tìm hương lạ, nhưng vợ tào khang thì cả đời chỉ có một thôi con ạ.

clips.camera: 24mm low aerial drone shot, slow rising pull-back from the shop doorway over the rooftops
beats: Low aerial view of a small corner shop in Hà Nội's old quarter at sunrise, a column of white steam rising from its empty golden doorway into the morning air.
@Thu steps into the doorway holding @Na's hand, the camera still low in front of them, and @Na looks up and asks her mother, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu answers her softly while looking out at the sunrise, her calm face and lips clearly visible in the golden light.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth with a smile as the camera rises over a sea of mossy tiled roofs, mother and daughter small in the glowing doorway beneath a wide golden sky.
clips.sfx: a soft morning wind, distant temple bells, the city waking
clips.setting: Sunrise over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter seen from a low drone: golden light, steam rising from the open doorway of a small sticky-rice shop on a corner street.
